text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup. The spectators 
express their disappointment over Symboli 
Rudolf's absence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first Japan Cup victory by a Japanese 
Umamusume. All those hopes were placed on 
Mr. C.B.'s shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mr. C.B. was in high spirits. 
Seeing Katsuragi Ace's fiercely
determined 
expression, her heart danced with 
excitement,
knowing this would be the best race.
